notes.title: Big Changes, Challenges and New Roadmap for Futariuum’s Gate 🚨
notes.notes:
[p]Hey everyone, Nethuum here.[/p][p]Thanks for your support so far and for playing our game. We enjoyed crafting the latest game update, but we've faced some major challenges that require adaptation to ensure the project continues. We appreciate if you could stick to us to know more about the changes-- I know, the following text is lengthy but I aim to be as open and honest as possible and didn't want to scrap any information that I think would be important for you to know. There's a TL;DR version below if you don't wanna everything, although I strongly recommend to![/p][p][/p][p][b]TL;DR (Short Version):[/b][/p][list][*][p][i]Our lead writer Tera left due to personal reasons, so we're shortening the story and dialogue—new backup writer on board, but change in story direction.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Other Challenges: Visibility/support dropped completely from one of our platforms; scope too ambitious for our 2-person team (Nethuum & AB) if no changes are made, risking burnout/delays; Ren'Py dungeon limits slow progress; censorship in adult games adds uncertainty.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Pivot: Emphasize deckbuilding roguelike loop (Slay the Spire-style) with short rewarding runs, blended with sphere scenes/side-quests and more; existing content stays.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Benefits: More frequent updates, lighter text, more cards/events/replayability and better balance between combat and sphere scenes; new animations as budget allows.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Changes will evolve with feedback.[/i][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]What's the Current Situation?[/b][/h3][p]As development progressed, we hit some challenging realities: [b]Our lead writer and co-founder Tera, had to leave the project due to personal reasons and no longer works with us[/b]. Tera's vision for the game was a key part, with a focus on an extensive and complex narrative. Without her, we have no choice other than [b]adjust the project's direction to align with our current capabilities and skills[/b]. We're working with a [b]new backup writer[/b]—who actually contributed to the update we released last week, including working on the entirety of Amanda's side-quest and the description of all the CGs— so the game won't be without writing, but it won't have the same writing direction as before.[/p][p]On top of that, one of our main support platforms besides Steam has been hit by controversial changes regarding adult games, leaving our page essentially "dead" there until things get reversed. That means less financial support, feedback and visibility.[/p][p]From our experience, combined with these factors, we've realized the game's scope became unrealistic for a two-person team. We had tons of plans and ideas, but I feel like it lacked a clear direction of the content we wanted to added until the full release. With Tera's departure and facing reality, we're shifting to a more realistic scope that lets us finish the game and avoid abandoning it, considering the scope is already ambitious.[/p][p]The current dungeon navigation system has limitations due to the Ren'Py engine, eating up too much time from the team and preventing us from adding content to more important areas like new cards and scenes, also requiring some changes.[/p][p]Plus, the [b]recent wave of censorship for adult games[/b] creates uncertainty and risk for an ambitious game like ours, especially since this is our main source of income. Finishing without major delays or issues is crucial for a small team like ours, now more than ever.[/p][p]With just two fixed full-time members left—me (Nethuum) and AB—[b]we're dealing with reduced capacity, less financial support besides Steam, and a scope that's grown beyond what we can handle.[/b] That's why we're changing [b]direction to play to our strengths, ensure the project survives, and we hope for your continued support[/b].[/p][p][/p][h3][b]What Does This Change Going Forward?[/b][/h3][p]Straight to the point: [b]What's already in the game won't be completely redone[/b]. Our original story vision was too ambitious and text-heavy, shaped in part by our former writer who's no longer on the team. Also, it really didn't feel like the visual novel elements and the card battle stuff went together very well. To ensure we can finish strong without delays, we're making a focused adjustment—the story will be shorter with less dialogue overall. Everything else stays the same, including the deckbuilding roguelike combat, sphere scenes, side-quests, etc.[/p][p]The good news: We're pivoting to emphasize what makes the game shine—[b]the deckbuilding roguelike dungeon loop and the sphere scenes[/b]! We'll prioritize a simpler, more realistic dungeon navigation system (inspired by Slay The Spire) that's rewarding and unpredictable, plus finishing sphere scenes and adding new side-quests.[/p][p]What really changes is [b]we're dialing back the heavy focus on a complex, linear story with tons of dialogue[/b] and aiming for better balance: [b]Short, rewarding card battles and dungeon runs with roguelike mechanics blended with sphere scenes and side-quests, with story bits sprinkled in post-run[/b]. The story will be shorter, unfolding gradually as you progress through battles and spheres.[/p][p]Oh, and new animations will roll out as the game's budget allows as well (they're quite expensive, especially now that we have one less platform to support us).[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Wrapping Up[/b][/h3][p]All these changes aren't set in stone and could evolve based on your feedback and the game's direction. Once we have a definitive roadmap and more details on what's coming next, we'll keep you posted in a future devlog.[/p][p]These shifts are crucial so AB and I can finish the game without getting overwhelmed by a scope beyond our means, or risking burnout or bigger budget issues if we stuck to the old path.[/p][p]Now more than ever, your support is key to the game's survival—so we'd really appreciate it if you could leave a review on Steam, grab a copy or just spread the word. We hope you understand, we're open to answering any questions, and we'll stay strong to bring you more and better updates. Thanks!
[/p][p][i]Nethuum[/i][/p]

notes.title: Futariuum’s Gate V0.45 (Christmas Update)
notes.notes:
Howdy all, Futariuum’s Gate followers!

We’ve got a bite-sized update for you all as a stocking stuffer for the holiday season! We’ve received a lot of feedback from the release of v0.40, and as we continue to work hard on the next content-rich update of Futariuum’s Gate, we wanted to show our gratitude with a handful of stuff for you to enjoy!

📝 [b]Features Overview[/b]:
- A brand-new, Christmas-themed outfit for Maya, which can be used in battle!
- A new Boss Demon, called “Blaze”. Defeat her burning desire and check out her new scorching-hot sex scene!
- Six new dungeons, with randomized layouts. Boss Demon “Blaze” can appear in these, as well as all the other Demons you’ve fought in the previous versions!
- 2 new cards for you to use and one as an unplayable card belonging to the Boss Demon “Blaze”!
- Chime now has banter and a functional store. Speak to Chime and see short conversations to get a little look into her personality and see what she has to negotiate!

🔎 [b]Changelog[/b]:

⚡ [b]Character [/b]⚡
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
- Added Boss Demon Blaze.

⚡ [b]Cards [/b]⚡
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
- Added 3 new cards.

⚡ [b]Cards [/b]⚡
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
- Added 3 new cards.

⚡ [b]Scenes[/b] ⚡
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
- Added a new scene: Maya x Blaze (3 VARIANTS).

⚡ [b]UI [/b]⚡
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
- Added the complete interface for Chime’s Store, organized by categories (buy, remove, and trade).

⚡[b]Dungeon[/b]⚡
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
- Added 6 new repeatable dungeons, each with several variants.
- Added a death system to the repeatable dungeons: now there's a chance that when you die, you'll unlock new cards.
- Introduced the outfit mechanic: Each outfit now provides specific bonuses for Maya.
- The demon boss Blaze has been strengthened: Their attack power, block, and HP have been increased.
- Made several fixes to the previous dungeons.

⚡ [b]Animation [/b]⚡
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
- Added an animation to Chime’s portrait in her store.

⚡ [b]Special [/b]⚡
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
- Added Maya’s Christmas special outfit for use during combat.

⚡ [b]Misc[/b] ⚡
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
- - Added a “remove” button to Chime’s Store.
- Added the repeatable dungeon "Abyssal Cave" icon to the navigation map.
- Added a “clear!” icon to the navigation map.
- Added a “buy” button to Chime’s Store.
- Added a “trade” button to Chime’s Store, along with icons for this section.
- Added a quest notification icon above the quest menu icon, which appears whenever a new quest is added.
- Added a visual slash/attack effect that appears on the character sprite whenever a character takes damage.
- Added a quick access button to transport the player to Chime’s Store.
- Added dialogues for Chime.
- Added more transition animations for Maya’s portrait.
- Added 4 new achievements (Steam only).
- Added keyboard-only functionality. Use the "D" key to open the deck menu.

⚡ [b]Fixes [/b]⚡
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
- Added a reward for the first Lesser Demon.
- Made several fixes to previous cards.
- The Thunder Spear card has been balanced, now dealing 14 damage with a cost of 50 mana, and the cost is displayed on the card.
- The uses of the Sanguination card will now reset before each battle.
- Belial Nerf:
    - In her first battle on normal difficulty, Belial's HP has been reduced from 125 to 100.
    - In her second battle, her attack power has been lowered from 15 to 14, but only if the difficulty is not set to easy.
- The battle now ends with a new transition and visual effect before going to the rewards screen.
- Added missing stars to some of the cards.
- Fixed card label from “attack” to “skill” for the Earthquake and Chaos Breaker cards.
- Fixed keymaps for the dorms.
- Updated the walkthrough (Utility Pack DLC).
- Updated the Art Pack DLC.
- Made several fixes throughout the game.

We’re still trucking along with the next, larger update for the game, including the content for Maya’s Sphere that the community has voted on, along with much more. Check out the new update and stay tuned for more!

Love, Gloomy Washer.
